body: Quick pass (UMA) @ 889f31d5: quick gate green on the gated tree (= committed head), clippy clean on app/ui, structural assertions added, no snapshot PNGs, body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1139 (on #1123).

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/job.rs, crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs, crates/app/tests/golden_cl.rs and crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs - the job builder, the kind-scoped stamp digest, the golden CL list and the pane registry all moved on both sides since your head; merge main and re-apply your additions on top. (plus a structural.rs test-list overlap)

Refresh note from M5 (for this PR's owning session): #551 and #560, the EDM base this draft was built on, merged to main at 14:06Z. This draft now conflicts, and its diff still carries the old copy of that base. When you next work it, one `git merge upstream/main` (keep both sides; take main's version of the #551/#560 files) should drop the duplicated base and shrink the diff. #1208 is different: wait until the sinker chain (#1131 → #1136 → #1156) merges, because it's built on it. The maintainer has decided reviews are NeoTech's only, so no pr-reviewer marker and no merge-ready from our sessions.

Merged the parent and main to resolve conflicts. The new head is 2dc69835.

- **Parent:** confirmed #1139 (`issue/533-wire-iso-post`) as this PR's parent. Its old head b9ddec58 is this branch's base, and none of #1144's commits are on this branch. I merged #1139's refreshed head 3dd4b820.
  - One conflict, in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`. Both sides had added separate tests in the same place: this PR's `wire_machine_editor_structure`, and main's `setup_page_workholding_rpm_row_structure`, `ribbon_labels_whole_and_captions_painted` and the origin-names check. I kept both sides.
- **upstream/main:** merged cleanly, with no further conflicts.
- `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the chain's own files. No snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG, RECOMMENDED or PROCESS_VERSION changes.
- **Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: post, motion, app and ui suites, 0 failed, 16.9 min. That run includes `wire_contour`, `wire_post`, `golden_cl` and the ui lib (structural). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The PR stays a draft. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed at 2dc6983 (stacked parents #551, #560, #1123, #1139 are all merged; the PR diff against main is 11 files, +475/-18). Stale `conflicts` label removed: the PR is MERGEABLE and my local trial merge with main was clean.

**Pages changed visually**
- Machine editor window: for a `wire_edm` machine a Wire EDM section (wire keys, `edm.codes` rows, condition table) replaces Spindle / Tooling / Coolants. The field area now scrolls, Apply / Revert stay in reach. Other machine kinds keep their layout.
- Wire Contour operation page: no Tool row, no Coolant row.
- Ribbon: a tool-less kind's Create cell is no longer held by an empty rack (tip and gate note follow).

**Screenshots:** the PR description carries no before/after screenshots (it only says PNG snapshots are unchanged). Note, not a blocker: please add them for the machine editor Wire section and the Wire Contour page.

**What looks good**
- No snapshot PNG, build.rs, scripts, `.github`, dependency or process-file change.
- Edits ride the existing `EditMachineApply` (one undo step), so no new command or MCP tool is owed; the refusal sits at the machine door (`holders.rs` `edm_refusal`, chained into `tooling_refusal`) and names the code or condition. No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; an untouched absent `edm` section stays absent.
- Real-event tests pin the flow (add condition, code without `{id}` refused by name, applied with it, one undo); structural twin updated; provenance line and decision file `docs/decisions/535-wire-ui.md` present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #535`.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib `edm_refusal` test | 1 passed |
| app `edm_machine` / `machine_edit` / `wire_contour` / `machine` | 5 / 33 / 12 / 7 passed |
| ui `--lib` (CWD crates/ui) | 644 passed, 5 ignored (includes the 3 new wire tests) |
| ui `machine` / `boundary` | 3 / 6 passed |
| clippy -D warnings, camcraft-app + camcraft-ui, all targets | clean |

I ran the touched suites, not the full quick-gate plan (it expands to about 50 app suites through the `app::machine` gate map).

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:592-600`: the new `no_tool_for` helper was inserted between the existing doc comment ("... for creating kind `i` against the active setup's tools ...") and `tool_law_note`, so that comment now sits on the wrong function. Move it back above `tool_law_note`.
2. `panes.rs` is 1492 lines and `op_page.rs` 415 (already over the ~400 guide before this PR; flagged only).
3. Not exercised by the author: picking the start hole in the viewport, a real wire control, sinker keys.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
